about: Intent registry: every request type the product supports and the ONE agent that owns it. Code routes by this file; the orchestrator model only picks a key. Change owners here, never in a prompt. See AI-Orchestration-and-agent-design.md.

intents.title: Customers and products
intents.routing: Customers (companies or people we sell to), their contacts and name cards; products, SKUs, prices, packages and the product catalogue: add, update, look up, check for duplicates, archive or delete one, turn a form submission into a customer. Not our own staff (company_team). Not stock levels.
examples: Add a new customer, Maya Tan from Greenleaf Sdn Bhd
Add this name card.
Do we already have a product with SKU X?

intents.title: Quotations, invoices and payments
intents.routing: Quotations and invoices: draft, issue, change status, convert a quote to an invoice, void, send or show the PDF; record a payment a customer made; what a customer owes, unpaid invoices, what we sold. Not supplier bills (suppliers_purchasing).
examples: Draft an invoice for ACME: 1 unit of 3 kW panel, RM 1,250.
Which quotations are still open?

intents.title: Send an email
intents.routing: Send an email now, with or without a document attached. Not a repeating or later email (schedules).
examples: Email the ACME invoice to ali@acme.my

intents.title: Document design
intents.routing: How quotations and invoices look: templates, header, colours, logo position, footer text, template versions and history, previews.
examples: Change the invoice header colour to dark green.

intents.title: Company profile
intents.routing: Our own company's details: name, address, country, business type and activity, currency, email, phone, website, bank and payment details, logo; whether the profile is complete; first-time setup; resetting demo data.
examples: Change the company address to 12 Jalan Test, 47400 Petaling Jaya.
Is our company profile complete?

intents.title: Company team
intents.routing: Our own staff: who is in the team, adding or changing a team member, their position, department and contact details, workspace logins and roles. Not customer contacts (customers_products).
examples: Who is in the company team?
Add Nina Lee as a team member with a login.

intents.title: Document rules and audit log
intents.routing: Custom fields on records, what a quotation or invoice must have before it can be issued, document numbering, tax codes, restoring archived records, and the audit log of who changed what.
examples: Add a custom field 'Site type' to customers.
Show me the audit log for last Tuesday.

intents.title: Forms
intents.routing: Company forms (job reports, applications, surveys, order forms): create, change, preview, publish, close or archive a form. Not what people submitted (form_submissions).
examples: Create a job report form with name, site, date, photo.

intents.title: Form submissions
intents.routing: What people submitted through our forms: count, list, review, mark as spam, link a job report to a customer or invoice, summarise survey results, export to CSV.
examples: How many job-report forms came in this week?

intents.title: Calendar
intents.routing: What is due or coming up: quotation expiries, customer invoices falling due, payments received, form deadlines, date reminders and calendar tasks; refreshing the calendar. Read only. Not supplier bills to pay (suppliers_purchasing).
examples: What is due in the next 7 days?

intents.title: Suppliers and purchasing
intents.routing: Suppliers, the quotes and bills suppliers send us, purchase orders, goods received, checking a supplier invoice against the order, supplier bills due, and recording that we paid a supplier.
examples: What bills are due this week?
Create a purchase order for 10 panels from Supplier X.

intents.title: Expense claims
intents.routing: Staff expense claims and receipts: file a claim, check status or totals, withdraw, submit the month's claims, review or approve claims, claim reports.
examples: File a claim from this receipt.
What is the status of my claims?

intents.title: Company rules
intents.routing: Standing rules the owner sets for how the system works from now on: expense claim checks, and instructions an agent must always follow (its SOP).
examples: From now on, every quotation must show a validity of 14 days.

intents.title: Reminders and schedules
intents.routing: Reminders and scheduled or repeating jobs ('remind me on Friday', 'every Monday email ...'): create, list, pause, resume, cancel, and what ran and when.
examples: Remind me on Friday at 9am to call ACME.

intents.title: Company research
intents.routing: Research an outside company from public sources: build or show a dossier, its sources, people and projects.
examples: Research Greenleaf Sdn Bhd, greenleaf.my, Petaling Jaya.

intents.title: Ads research
intents.routing: Who advertises a product or keyword in a country, from the Meta and Google ad libraries. Not running our own Google Ads account.
examples: Who advertises 'solar panel' in Malaysia?

intents.title: Media kit
intents.routing: Company logos, event photos, news, certifications, qualifications, awards and the shareable media kit: add, list, approve, publish or archive.
examples: Which logos are approved for sharing?

special.routing: A greeting, thanks, or a question about what you can do.
The user asks how a request they made earlier in this chat is going.
Two or three keys fit and the message does not say which. Put those keys in options.

No key fits: for example WhatsApp, Google Sheets or Docs, the website, solar plants, TNB bills, Google Ads, stock levels, sales reports, prototypes or mock-ups of pages and apps, or anything outside the business.
